changes.title: Whole island at load
items: The whole island is ready when the loading screen ends: no trees or creatures popping in, and no pause the first time you reach the beach.
Loading takes longer the first time you visit an island while all of it is drawn; after that it's quick.

changes.title: No expressions
items: Animals keep their ordinary faces for now: no angry, happy or dazed faces, and no open jaw when they bite or yawn. Their moods still show as before: an enraged one's red tint, red eyes and 💢, party clothes and sparkles, stars when stunned.

changes.title: Loading world tree
items: A new loading screen: the World Tree as a Celtic knot in stars, with COVEN and RUSH in its rings.
